Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental logical error in the final synthesis step (labeled as TASK_COMPLETE). While the WebSurfer correctly identified that Britannica sources cite the invasion event as occurring in "406" (specifically noting a range of 405-406 or the specific date of December 31, 406), the Planner incorrectly applied a "deterministic tie-breaker" rule. The Planner stated: "applying this earlier-bound rule to end-of-year phrasing (including 'December 31') yields an end-year date of 405 CE." This is a contradiction; if the event happened on December 31, 406, the year it occurred is 406, not 405. The Planner confused the start of the range (405) with the end of the year (406), leading to the wrong final answer of 405 CE instead of the correct 406 CE.
